module_summary: AXI-stream to UART transmitter: accepts a byte on valid/ready, loads a 9-bit shift register and shifts start/data/stop bits out, timed by a prescale counter and bit counter.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input byte loaded into the transmit shift register on accept.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: AXI-stream valid; starts a frame when idle and bit_cnt is zero.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: AXI-stream ready, copy of s_axis_tready_reg, asserted while transmitter is idle.

anchors.name: txd
anchors.why: Serial UART output line driven from txd_reg.

anchors.name: data_reg
anchors.why: Shift register holding data plus stop bit, shifted into txd_reg each bit period.

anchors.name: prescale_reg
anchors.why: Bit-period down-counter reloaded from prescale; gates shifting and ready.

anchors.name: bit_cnt
anchors.why: Counts remaining bits of frame; zero means idle and ready for new byte.

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Level busy indication while a frame is being transmitted.

anchors.name: prescale
anchors.why: Baud prescale configuration input reloading prescale_reg.

groups.name: axis_input
groups.description: AXI-stream input handshake accepting bytes when transmitter idle.

groups.name: tx_shifter
groups.description: Shift register serializing start, data and stop bits onto txd.

groups.name: baud_timing
groups.description: Prescale and bit counters sequencing frame bits and busy status.
